title: mentha × rotundifolia var. elongata
intro: Mentha × rotundifolia var. elongata, commonly known as Irish pepper mint, is a variant of the peppermint plant that is native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including relief from digestive issues, nausea, and headaches, due to its ability to ease inflammation and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Irish pepper mint include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents such as menthol, menthone, and limonene. The bioactive constituents in Irish pepper mint have been found to have antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
